book.name: LUKA
book.title: MUSELU WAPAMA WA YESU woolebiwa ni Luka

content: Wiiwananeliwa
Mudhidhi wa mathanga a mikaathe dhohukanna emela, yeeriwa Paxkwa waaddamelaga.
Apogo a anamakutha ni anamasuuziha a malamulo yoosayelaga mukalelo wowi empe Yesu, mbwenye yowawoova athu.
Vano Sathana ahivolowa mmurimani mwa Zhuda, eeriwa Esikariyothi, mmohi wa kumi ni abiili.
Oliye ahidhowa wa apogo a anamakutha, ni ale yaang'anela nyuba ya Mulugu wi yeewananele mukalelo wompeleka Yesu.
Aliwa yahidhiveliwa, wiiwananela omvaha korowa.
Oliye orumeedha, osayelaga mudhidhi wompeleka anamwinji ehilivo.
Yooja ya Nabwiya
Vano nigafiyile nlabo na mathanga a mikaathe dhohukanna emela, vapiwa mwaana nibila a mukutho wa Paxkwa.
Yesu ahimuruma Peduru ni Zhuwawu, eeraga: “Kaweni mwasasanyedhe dhooja dha Paxkwa wi nije.”
Aliwa yahimukohaga, wiira: “Munafuna nasasanyedhe dhoojadha waani?”
Yesu ahawaakula, wiira: “Mwavolowaga muluwani, muneere omfwanya mulobwana mmohi agathukulile muno wa mahinje. Mmuharege vade vineeriye avolowe.
Mmukohe mwiinya a vade, mwiire: ‘Namasuuziha wiire: Suubi owi Gijelemo mathanga a Paxkwa ni anamasuuza aaga oli waani?’
Oliye onowuwoonihani suubi mulubale a vadhulu, mwemo muli dhatedhene dhoofuneya vamathangani. Musasanyedhemo dhoojadha.”
Aliwa edhowaga yahifwanya dhatedhene woona mwawaaddelege Yesu, osasanyedha mathanga a Paxkwa.
Vano mudhidhi ogaakwanile, Yesu ahikaratigi vameeza vamohi ni arumiwi aaye.
Ahiwogaga, wiira: “Ginofuna vajinjivene wi nimuje vamohi Paxkwa ola dhihinafiye dhoovoreya dhaaga.
Ginowuwaaddelani wi kagidha Gimuja mmohi ofiyedha aakwanelihiwe muMweneni wa Mulugu.”
Ageere ndo, ahithukula nakoma a vinyu, ovahedha mahala, wiira: “Mwaakeleni, mmugawane mwateene mukaleliinyu.
Ginowuwaaddelani wi kagidha Ging'wa, dhoovaha dha muthanko wa uuva
dila emohi ofiyedha odha Omwene wa Mulugu.”
Vano ahithukulaga mukaathe, ovahedha mahala, ogwaddanya, waavaha, wiira: “Ola bu mwiili waaga onavahiwa wa nyo; mwiiregena ndo moogubuwelela.”
Ni mukalelo wankeene, egamalile oja, ahimuthukulaga nakoma, wiira: “Ola di nakoma owaandana wuxa wa mwazi waaga, onavuuvela wa nyo.
“Mbwenye moone muthu ole onafuna ogiguliha oli ni miyovano vameeza veva.
Ebaribareene, Mwaana a Muthu, oneere opiwa woona mwafuneyeliwa, mbwenye oneere woona muthu oyene onagigulihe!”
Vano arumiwi yahambeelaga okohana vakaleligiisu, yiiraga mwa aliwa, wi eerena dhendo baani.
Teto wahikalaga ovaanyihana vakaleligiisu, yiiraga wi mwa aliwa aali oofuneya baani.
Yesu ahawaaddela, wiira: “Mamwene a athu oode enowaathonga athu eewa; ale enaathonga eneeriwa anameerana dhapama.
Mbwenye, nyo kamunaakale ndo. Mohiyaniha, mpogo mwa nyo onaakale woona mung'ono. Vano ole onasogolela onakala woona ole oneemelela.
Ki oofuneya baani: di ole oli vameeza naari ole oneemelela? Kahuwo ole onaja vameeza? Mbwenye Miyo Gili vaari va nyo woona ole oneemelela.
Nyo muli alene munakalave ni Miyo moweehiwani mwaaga.
Woona ababa egisakulele Omwene, Miyo Ginowusakulani;
wi muje, mung'we vameeza vaaga muMweneni mwaaga, muneere okaraati mwiittenguni, wi mwaathonge malogo kumi ni meenddi a Ezarayeli.”
Teto Yesu ahiwogaga, wiira: “Simawu, Simawu, woone, Sathana ohuwaddihedha wi oveetteni woona tirigu.
Mbwenye Miyo Guhuulobelela wi nroromelo naawo nihithime. Wadha otthwaruwa, waalibihe addibilo.”
Mbwenye Peduru ahaakula, wiira: “Gili owimeleene odhowa ofugeliwa ni nyo, ofiyedha okwa.”
Mbwenye Yesu ahaakula, wiira: “Miyo Ginowuwaaddela Peduru, peeno veva, mutubi ahineebe ‘kokoliko,’ onogikoodda dila thaaru wiiraga wi kuginonile.”

Vano, Yesu ahaakohaga anamasuuza aaye, wiira: “Voorumilimini voolenddoni Giiraga wi kamuthukule thumba na korowa, naari thumba na olenddo, naari sapatho; yahikalavo yohaleeleni?” Aliwa wiira: “Kanahaleeliwe yego.”
Oliye wawaaddela, wiira: “Mbwenye dhiinova, winna thumba na korowa, athukule; ni thumba na voolenddoni; ole ohinna supadda, agulihe yowiikunelana yaaye wi agulena naaye.
Ginowuwaaddelani, enofuneya dhigipadduwele dhendo dhilebiwe: ‘Wi oliye oneere otaganyihedhiwa ni anameerana dhabure.’
Ebaribareene dhatedhene dhinawoga dha Miyo dhinofuneya dhaakwanelihiwe.”
Aliwa yahimwiirelaga: “Nabwiyani, nihikanna masupadda meenddi ala!” Waakula, wiira: “Baahi, ehaakwana.”
Yesu Onoolobela va Mwaangoni wa Olivera
Vano ahivenyaga odhowa oMwangoni wa Olivera, woona molemeelela, ni anamasuuza aaye vamohi.
Egafiyile mburo, wasakuliwe, ahiiraga: “Lobelani, mulobaga wi munamorele moweehiwani.”
Ahisusaga vang'ono, olapelawa woona vinamorela nibwe muthu avoka, ahikokoraga, wambeela olobela.
Alobelagave, ahiiraga: “Babani, mwafuna Girabeliheni nakoma a masoso ola; mbwenye ohiireye ofuna waaga, wiireye ofuna weenyu.”
Vano mungero oodhulu ahimoneyela wi amulibihe mmurimani.
Yesu agali mmasosoni, oolobelagave ni kopolo. Nikurumela naaye naaligi woona mathotho a mwazi waddonddelaga vati.
Agamalile olobela, ahivenyaga, owelawo omburoni waaligi anamasuuza; aafwanyilege egonaga, vowi okubanya weewa wahithabwaga.
Oliye wiira: “Munagonela ddi? Mvenye, mulobele wi munamorele moweehiwani!”
Ohiddiwa wa Yesu
Yesu awogagave, yahifiyaga athu ajinjeene ni mmohi wa anamasuuza kumi ni abiili, eeriwa Zhuda, aaligi vasogolo. Ahisusedhaga vaaligi Yesu wi amulojele ni bezhu.
Yesu owoga ni oliye, wiira: “Zhuda, onafuna omugulihe Mwaana a Muthu ni ombezhari?
Vano anamasuuza a Yesu yamwapelelege vevale yoonaga dhafunaga opadduwa, yahimukohaga: “Nabwiya, munofuna naaporose ni masupadda eehu athu ala?”
Mmohi ahikumihaga supadda, omporosa mwiimeleli a mpogo a anamakutha. Ompadha nibaru na omoononi wooja.
Yesu waahiha, wiira: “Baahi! Iyani!” Oliye okahinya nibaru ovoliha.

Vano Yesu ahiwogaga ni apogo a anamakutha, anamaang'anela a nyuba ya Mulugu ni makolo a mutugumano, yadhiilege wi emwihidde, wiira: “Nyo munadha ni masupadda, ni golomonddo wi mugihidde. Wiirege Gili mbava?
Malabo mateene Gakala ni nyoovo nyuba ya Mulugu, mbwenye kamugihiddile. Mudhidhi ola bweenyu. Si kopolo dha mwipipini.”
Peduru Onomukoodda Yesu
Vano egamwihiddile Yesu, yahimudhowana vade va mpogo a anamakutha. Peduru egi waahara voolapelavene.
Yahitubaanyaga muunddo vaari vattaddo egakaraatile ateene, Peduru ahifiyaga mburo olene, okeraati ni aliwa.
Mwiimeleli mmohi amwihiyana ahimoonaga Peduru vakaratiligiye vooneyelaga muundd. Omusugwesesa Peduru, wiira: “Mulobwana ola akala ni Oliyeene!”
Mbwenye Peduru okooddaga, eeraga: “Asaa! Mwihiyana we, miyo kagimunonile.”
Vigavirile mudhidhi vang'onove, mwiimeleli mmohi agamoonile, ahiiraga: “Teto we oli mmohi mwa aliwa.” Peduru wiira: “Mulobwana we miyo kagili.”
Vigavirile mudhidhi wowaakwana wora emohi, muthu mmohiya ahikalelaga ntidi, eeraga: “Ebaribareene ola aali ni Oliyeene, vowi muGalileya.”
Mbwenye Peduru ahikalelaga ntidi okoodda, eeraga: “Mulobwana we, miyo dhinawogiiwe, kaginonile!” Awogagave ndo, mutubi ahiibaga.
Nabwiya ahirugunuwaga, omusugwesa. Peduru wuubuwela madhu yamwaaddelile Nabwiya: “Owi peeno veva mutubi ahineebe, onogikoodda dila thaaru.”
Vano Peduru ahivenyagavo, odhowa wuunddaga ni okubanya wulubale.
Anyakoddo Enombedda Yesu.
Alobwana yamwaang'anelaga Yesu yoombeddaga emuddwadhaga.
Yoomukuneelaga meento, yiiraga: “Ovuhulele! Wuddwadhile baani?”
Yoomuwogelaga dhego dhijinjidhene emunyemulaga.
Yesu Agali va Pilatu ni Heroddi
Ode ogasile bebeheene, makolo a mutugumano a mulogo wa Ezarayeli, apogo a anamakutha, ni ale yasuuziha malamulo yahitugumanaga, omuthukula Yesu omudhowana omuthegoni weewa.
Omukohaga, yiiraga: “Akala oli Kirixtu, onaaddele.” Oliye wawaakula, eeraga: “Naari Guwaaddeleni, kamunarumeedha.
Naari Guukohani, kamunagaakula yego.
Okuma dhiinoveva munomoona Mwaana a Muthu agakaratile omoononi wooja wa Mulugu winna kopolo dhatedhene.”
Athu ateene wiira: “We oli Mwaana a Mulugu?” Oliye waakula, eeraga: “Nyoovo dinawoga wi Gili.”
Yahiiraga: “Ki ninafunelege ddi onamoona? Vowi nihiiwa weekihu dha muwano mwaaye.”
